# `foxglove site-notification-tokens list`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](site-notification-tokens.md)

```text
List site notification tokens

Usage: foxglove site-notification-tokens list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render output in table, JSON, or CSV format

          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json, csv]

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --site-id <SITE_ID>

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
```
